师傅，守艺，也破局: Master Craftsmen: Preserving Craft and Breaking New Ground
当下，AI（人工智能）渗入各行各业: Currently, AI is permeating all industries and sectors.
AI知道得太多了，它24小时在线，能调用人类文明几乎所有的公开知识: AI knows too much; it is online 24 hours and can access nearly all public knowledge of human civilization.
如果你想学一项技能，AI甚至能比一些金牌师傅讲得更清楚、更系统: If you want to learn a skill, AI can even explain it more clearly and systematically than some master craftsmen.
现在，人在干活，AI在记录，人工智能可以精准复现每一个动作，而且更快、更稳、更准: Now, as people work, AI records, and artificial intelligence can precisely replicate every movement, faster, more steadily, and more accurately, so where does the value of a master craftsman lie?
当AI给出10种方案时，师傅的价值在于挑出最有效的那一个: When AI presents 10 solutions, a master craftsman's value lies in picking the most effective one.
当AI出错时，师傅的价值在于第一时间发现异常: When AI makes an error, a master craftsman's value lies in detecting the anomaly at the first moment.
AI教做事，师傅教做人: AI teaches how to do things; master craftsmen teach how to be a person.
如今，AI拆解动作、模拟训练，做得比人还快还准: Nowadays, AI breaks down movements and simulates training, doing it faster and more accurately than humans.
但是，和“技”长在一起的那些“道”——守住底线、把握分寸、扛起责任，以及临场判断: However, the "principles" that grow alongside "techniques" — holding the line, exercising judgment, shouldering responsibility, the intuition of on-the-spot decision-making, the balancing of gray areas, composure under pressure, steadfastness in the face of temptation — AI still cannot do these, and they still require flesh-and-blood, empathetic, discerning master craftsmen to "show the way."
AI时代，师傅传什么: In the AI Era, What Should Master Craftsmen Pass On?
不光传手艺与知识——这些AI懂得更多，今天更要传的，是职业态度，是劳动精神: Not just passing on craftsmanship and knowledge — AI understands these better — but rather what must be passed on today is professional attitude and the spirit of labor.
AI可以复制她的每个动作，却回答不了：为什么要守着一朵花这么多年: AI can replicate her every movement, but it cannot answer: why hold onto a single flower for so many years.
